text.en:
Meena's cousin in Rajasthan said it is hot and dry there while Chennai is warm and humid.
"Why so different?" asked Meena.

Climate is the average weather of a place over many years. India has a monsoon climate, but it differs by region because of distance from the sea, height and latitude.
Coastal places like Chennai and Mumbai have a small difference between summer and winter. Inland places like Delhi have extreme heat and cold. Hill places are cooler.
The Thar Desert gets very little rain, while Mawsynram in Meghalaya is among the wettest places on Earth.

problem.en: Why is Delhi hotter in summer than Chennai?

text.en: Delhi is far from the sea.

prompt.en: A friend says weather and climate are the same. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Weather is daily; climate is long-term average.
